name: 35043 · Chelsea, AL
findings: ZIP 35043 (Chelsea) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35043 (Chelsea) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35043 (Chelsea) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
